<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story**

**As a** user browsing the product listing page,  
**I want** to see how many products match my current filters and have quick access to sorting and filtering options,  
**So that** I can efficiently narrow down and organize the results to find what I'm looking for.

### Requirements

| **Accessibility Requirements:** **Keyboard Navigation:** All interactive elements (buttons, dropdowns) must be reachable and operable via keyboard (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys). **ARIA Roles & Attributes:** Use appropriate ARIA roles: `aria-haspopup="dialog"` or `menu` for buttons that open modals or dropdowns. Include `aria-expanded` to reflect open/closed state of filters or sort menus. Ensure live updates (like product count) use `aria-live="polite"` to announce changes for screen readers. **Focus Management:** When a modal or menu is opened, focus should shift to the first focusable element inside. Focus should return to the trigger element (e.g., "All Filters" button) when the modal/menu is closed. **Screen Reader Support:** Buttons should have clear, descriptive labels (e.g., `aria-label="Open all filters"`). Product count should be announced clearly (e.g., "Showing 45 products"). |  |

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Standard Filter Bar provides the primary interface for users to refine and organize product results on a product listing page. It serves as the central control point for all filtering and sorting interactions, maintaining visibility of the current filter state while offering quick access to additional options.

## Use Cases

- Display and dynamically update product count as filters change
- Provide one-click access to the full filter sheet via the "All filters" button
- Enable quick sorting through a dedicated dropdown menu
- Show currently active filters as removable tag buttons for easy modification
- Offer bulk filter reset when many filters are applied

## Design Rationale

The component implements sticky positioning behavior that intelligently coordinates with the shop header, ensuring filter controls remain accessible during scroll without interfering with navigation. The design follows Shopify standards while supporting Google Retail Connect integration for enhanced filtering capabilities. Accessibility is prioritized through comprehensive keyboard navigation and screen reader support via ARIA attributes.
